nodes.prompt:
Implement Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 of NOTIFICATION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md in rorca (/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite).

Tasks:
1. Update `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`:
   - Add `tauri-plugin-notification = "2"`
   - Add `tauri-plugin-dialog = "2"`
   - Add `rodio = { version = "0.22", default-features = false, features = ["symphonia-default"] }` (or standard rodio features for mp3/wav/ogg playback)
   - On macOS (`target_os = "macos"`), add dependencies needed for UNUserNotificationCenter / authorization if required, or implement safe fallback.
2. Create `src-tauri/src/notification/` module:
   - `model.rs` / `service.rs`: Notification dispatching, content formatting/sanitization, permission DTOs (`NotificationPermissionStatusDto`, `NotificationPermissionRequestDto`), probe logic, custom audio playback via `rodio` (`NotificationAudioPlayer`).
   - `mod.rs`: export notification services.
3. Create `src-tauri/src/ipc/notifications.rs`:
   - Implement Tauri commands:
     - `cmd_notification_dispatch`
     - `cmd_notification_get_permission_status`
     - `cmd_notification_request_permission`
     - `cmd_notification_probe_delivery`
     - `cmd_notification_open_system_settings`
     - `cmd_notification_play_sound`
     - `cmd_notification_pick_audio`
4. Register commands and plugins in `src-tauri/src/ipc/mod.rs` and `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`.
5. Add comprehensive unit tests in `src-tauri/src/notification/` and `src-tauri/src/ipc/notifications.rs`. Verify `cargo check` and `cargo test` pass.

STOP WHEN: `cargo check` passes cleanly and unit tests for notification DTOs/services succeed.

nodes.prompt:
Implement Phase 4 and Phase 7 of NOTIFICATION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md in rorca (/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite).

Tasks:
1. Update `ui/src/lib/types.ts` & `ui/src/lib/tauri.ts`:
   - Add notification types: `NotificationDispatchArgs`, `NotificationDispatchResult`, `NotificationPermissionStatus`, `NotificationPermissionRequestArgs`, `NotificationProbeArgs`, `NotificationProbeResult`, `NotificationPlaySoundArgs`, `NotificationPlaySoundResult`, `NotificationPickAudioResult`.
   - Add wrapper functions for all backend notification IPC commands in `ui/src/lib/tauri.ts`.
2. Implement `ui/src/lib/notificationSettings.ts` (and unit test `ui/src/lib/notificationSettings.test.ts`):
   - Settings structure: `enabled: boolean`, `agentTaskComplete: boolean`, `terminalBell: boolean`, `customSoundId: "system" | "none" | "custom" | string`, `customSoundPath: string | null`, `customSoundVolume: number (0.0 to 1.0)`.
   - LocalStorage persistence with validation, safe fallbacks, and event listener for cross-component sync.
3. Update workspace state in `ui/src/state/` to track Unread state:
   - Add unread flags to terminal tabs / worktrees in `workspaceStore.ts` or a dedicated unread tracking slice.
   - Add actions: `markTabUnread(tabId)`, `clearTabUnread(tabId)`, `markWorktreeUnread(worktreeId)`, `clearWorktreeUnread(worktreeId)`.
   - Ensure unread state clears automatically when switching to/viewing that tab or worktree.
   - Update `TabBar.tsx` and `WorktreeList.tsx` / `Sidebar.tsx` to render subtle unread status dots/badges.
4. Add Vitest unit tests for `notificationSettings.test.ts`, `tauri.test.ts` (mocked IPC), and unread state management.

STOP WHEN: `bun run test` passes for the new frontend modules and types without any TypeScript errors (`bun run typecheck` or `tsc --noEmit`).

nodes.prompt:
Implement Phase 5, Phase 6, and Phase 8 of NOTIFICATION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md in rorca (/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite).

Tasks:
1. Implement Notification Coordinator (`ui/src/lib/notificationCoordinator.ts` or `ui/src/state/useNotificationCoordinator.ts`):
   - Foreground check: `document.visibilityState === "visible" && document.hasFocus()`.
   - Terminal Bell handling: connect with xterm `onBell`, implement per-session/PTY throttling (dedupe within 1 second cooldown).
   - Agent Task Completion handling: track agent status transitions and commit edge detection. Precedence rule: agent completion takes precedence over adjacent bell.
   - Notification dispatch + Sound playback flow: gate on `settings.enabled`, `settings.terminalBell`, `settings.agentTaskComplete`, dispatch notification if backgrounded, update unread state if inactive tab.
2. Integrate coordinator into `TerminalSplitView.tsx` / `TerminalPane.tsx` / `App.tsx`.
3. Implement `Notifications` settings pane in `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx`:
   - Add `Notifications` to `SettingsSection` and sidebar navigation with icon (`Bell`).
   - Master toggle (`Enable Notifications`).
   - Sub-toggles: `Agent Task Complete`, `Terminal Bell`.
   - Sound selection: System Default, None, Custom Audio File (with "Browse..." button using `pickAudio` and test play button).
   - Volume slider with percentage and live preview sound button.
   - "Send Test Notification" button for manual verification.
   - Permission status card (showing current OS permission status and "Open System Settings" button if denied/prompt).
4. Write thorough tests for coordinator and SettingsDialog in `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx` and `ui/src/lib/notificationCoordinator.test.ts`.

STOP WHEN: All Vitest unit tests pass and `SettingsDialog` renders the complete Notifications section.
